title.zh: StarkWare 在比特币主网上实现量子安全锁定方案，无需硬分叉但尚不适合大规模使用
title.en: StarkWare 在比特币主网上实现量子安全锁定方案，无需硬分叉但尚不适合大规模使用

current_state.zh: StarkWare researchers published and mainnet-verified a hash-based quantum-safe locking scheme for Bitcoin that needs no soft fork or consensus change, but it remains an emergency-only research fallback with heavy compute costs and no wallet or relay support.
